privacy.title: East Valley Naturopathic Doctors Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
SMS Messaging Data Privacy Policy

1. INTRODUCTION

East Valley Naturopathic Doctors is committed to protecting the privacy of our customers. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in connection with our SMS messaging program.

2. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

You may opt in to receive SMS messages from East Valley Naturopathic Doctors through our automated phone system (IVR). When you call in, the system plays a recorded prompt describing the SMS program and records your consent only when you select the designated menu option to agree.

In connection with our SMS messaging program, we may collect:

Phone number provided at opt-in

Name (if provided)

Opt-in consent and date

Message interaction data

3. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We use your information only to:

Send you the SMS messages you have consented to receive

Manage your opt-in and opt-out preferences

Comply with carrier and regulatory requirements

We do NOT use your phone number for any purpose beyond the SMS program you opted into.

4. DATA SHARING

Mobile information will not be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your mobile phone number or SMS opt-in status to any third party for any purpose.

5. YOUR DATA RIGHTS

You have the right to:

Request access to the personal data we hold about you in connection with our SMS program Request correction of inaccurate personal data

Request deletion of your personal data from our SMS program records

Withdraw consent to receive SMS communications at any time

To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the information in Section 6 below. Full messaging program terms are available in our Terms & Conditions: www.eastvalleynd.com/privacy

6. CONTACT US FOR PRIVACY QUESTIONS

East Valley Naturopathic Doctors

Website: https://www.eastvalleynd.com/

Phone: 4809850000

Email: patientcare@eastvalleynd.com

7. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

East Valley Naturopathic Doctors reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted at www.eastvalleynd.com/privacy.

8. EFFECTIVE DATE

July 30, 2026

messagingTerms.title: East Valley Naturopathic Doctors SMS Messaging Terms & Conditions
messagingTerms.html:
Messaging Terms of Service

1. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION

You agree to receive the following types of messages from East Valley Naturopathic Doctors: East Valley Naturopathic Doctors sends appointment reminders and customer care messages to patients who opt in via automated phone system. Messages include appointment confirmations, scheduling information, and responses to patient inquiries. Message frequency varies based on patient interaction and appointment schedule, typically 1-5 messages per month.

2. HOW WE COLLECT YOUR CONSENT

You may opt in to receive SMS messages from East Valley Naturopathic Doctors through our automated phone system (IVR). When you call in, the system plays a recorded prompt describing the SMS program and records your consent only when you select the designated menu option to agree.

3. MESSAGE FREQUENCY

Message frequency varies based on patient interaction and appointment schedule, typically 1-5 messages per month

4. COSTS

Message and data rates may apply. Check with your mobile carrier for details.

5. HOW TO GET HELP

For help with our SMS program, reply HELP to any message.

You can also contact us directly:

Website: https://www.eastvalleynd.com/

Phone: 4809850000

Email: patientcare@eastvalleynd.com

6. HOW TO OPT OUT

You can opt out of our SMS program at any time. Reply STOP, END, UNSUBSCRIBE, or CANCEL to any message. After opting out, you will receive one final confirmation and no further messages will be sent. To re-subscribe, reply START.

7. CONSENT

Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of purchase or service. You may opt out at any time without affecting your relationship with East Valley Naturopathic Doctors.

8. PRIVACY

Your mobile phone number and opt-in consent will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy: www.eastvalleynd.com/privacy.

Mobile information will not be shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

9. EFFECTIVE DATE & CONTACT

Effective: July 30, 2026
